dedupe_keys.name: arcep fibre to the home network quality indicators

description: This dataset holds the data behind Arcep's observatory of the quality of French fibre-to-the-home networks, collected from commercial operators and infrastructure operators. It gives, network by network and département by département, indicators such as the failure rate of connection orders, the rate of failures and damage caused during connections, the time to repair faults and the share of lines with incidents, averaged over rolling six-month periods, with a monthly history. Coverage: all French FTTH networks, network and département level, from November 2022. Format and access: four CSV files updated quarterly on data.gouv.fr, with the observatory page on arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: indicators are self-reported by operators; the list of networks and some definitions changed between releases; no individual faults are published. Simulation uses: condition and service performance indicators of fibre access networks for reliability modelling, repair-time assumptions in restoration studies, and comparison of infrastructure operators. Related records: the Arcep FTTH deployment data give the size of each network, and Arcep unavailable sites give mobile outages.
